body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy declares a single-target Action against you, before rolling. Response: On success, impose -1 on its Success Die and move yourself 1 unit before its roll; recheck range.

surges.html: On a hit, its target space provides concealment afterward until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, the enemy is Distracted after the Action until the start of your next turn.
